deployments_detail.use: AI-powered defect detection and quality inspection in auto-glass manufacturing

AI machine-vision quality inspection on automotive glass lines: deep-learning defect detection using 20-megapixel cameras achieving 0.01mm-grade precision and autonomous optical online inspection and cutting, replacing manual QC across every glass piece. [In-house (deep-learning vision)]
deployments_detail.value: 0.01mm inspection precision; ~30% defect-rate reduction after intelligent-equipment deployment

deployments_detail.use: AI-driven flexible/mixed-line production scheduling: intelligent algorithms optimize delivery deadlines and material inventory so a single line can switch among dozens of glass specifications within an hour (high-mix production). [In-house]

Smart factory with MES manufacturing-execution system plus industrial IoT and big-data optimization on fully automated production lines (interconnected sensors, real-time order-to-delivery optimization, ~600 tons/day). [In-house]
deployments_detail.value: production efficiency +30.5%; defect rate -30%; energy utilization +12%

deployments_detail.use: Robotic automation of glass production: ranks of robotic arms and a fleet of automated carriers move fragile panes; the Hefei plant runs ~90% automated production as the company's technological blueprint. [In-house / robotics]

AI intelligent-dimming privacy glass co-developed with XPeng for the XPeng GX: LC dye liquid-crystal glass integrated with the vehicle AI large model / voice assistant ('summon Xiao P') for second-level automatic dimming; 0.16s dimming response; mass-production delivery completed. [XPeng (AI large model / voice assistant); Fuyao (glass)]

'Yuguang' (御光) AI dimming panoramic sunroof: PDLC/EC dimming glass combined with AI algorithms that automatically adjust transparency based on ambient light, temperature, and user preferences. [In-house]
Digital-twin energy optimization across smart factories: predictive maintenance and optimized device-operation strategies driven by a digital twin to cut energy consumption. [In-house]

Cloud + digital backbone migration applying AI, big data and industrial IoT: consolidated 100+ heterogeneous systems onto a unified cloud (Oracle Fusion/SaaS) to support global intelligent management and data-driven operations. [Oracle Cloud]
